name: Cheek Media

notes: Cheek explicitly describes its editorial position as progressive and feminist. The linked newsletter illustrates its political commentary and editorial format. This is a national source, not a Brisbane local outlet merely because Ferguson studied in Queensland. No current Redland election coverage was verified.
